title: CASE D-8 — the redlined district
intro: Field Recovery reopened case ∅ and cross-referenced the ground itself: security-grade D, the district the 1937 map ringed in red. Three instruments made this block what it is. Read each one where it actually lives — in the public record, in the real world, in the maze — and the file opens the next.

stations.title: i · the map
stations.clue: The federal Residential Security Map graded this ground with a single letter and a single word — the lowest grade there was, printed in red. Not one building was inspected to earn it. Open the real map, find the red district, and read the word it was stamped with.

link.label: Mapping Inequality — the 1937 HOLC maps (University of Richmond)

stations.prompt: the one word the map stamped on grade D ground
stations.onSolve: the ground was graded. the hazard it scored was the people. now — what came for it, two generations on.

stations.title: ii · the record
stations.clue: Fifty years after the red line kept the money out, the same line was used to aim money designed to fail — loans steered into the districts the map had condemned. The city sued. Then the U.S. Department of Justice reached its own settlement with the bank, and put the figure on the public record. Open it and find the amount.

link.label: U.S. Department of Justice — the 2012 fair-lending settlement (archived)

stations.prompt: the settlement, in millions of dollars — digits only
stations.onSolve: first a wall against the money, then a funnel for it. the same red outline, used twice. one instrument left — the door itself.

stations.title: iii · the door
stations.where: the maze · level ∅ — or the record
stations.clue: The last instrument is the sealed door. Notice 30150A was posted on it in 2004 and never resolved — its status line reads one word, the only line in the whole file the system never closed. You can read that word in the maze: fall in at Level ∅, the block, and the notice on the door says it. Or find it in the record. Either way it is the same word, and it is the key.

link.label: the record — the notice (§05) and the fourth instrument (§06)

parity: in the maze — level ∅, the notice on the sealed door
stations.onSolve: never closed. never appealed. never demolished. extended — indefinitely. that is the door, and you have read it.

maze.hint: you are at the sealed door. the notice reads: EXTENSION. /file it.

reward.title: the district is read.
reward.text: Three instruments, three surfaces, one sentence that never reached a period: a map that graded the people as a hazard, a record that used the same line twice, and a door left open on purpose by a status the system never finalized. You read the block the way Field Recovery reads it. The case does not close — it extends. So file your claim where the presence waits.
